title: Mastra Live Workshop: Patterns for Production AI Agents
highlights: Live hands-on workshop focused on building and deploying production-ready AI agents. Covers multi-step reasoning, tool delegation, and reliable error-recovery patterns.

title: Mastra Live Workshop: Build a Software Factory with Mastra
highlights: Learn to design and orchestrate a multi-agent system that automates software development tasks from specification to code generation and testing.

title: Mastra Live Workshop: Build a Co-Working Agent with Mastra
highlights: Explores design patterns for collaborative AI agents that work alongside human developers in shared workspaces, managing state and context dynamically.

title: Mastra Live Workshop: Building Long-Running Agents with Mastra
highlights: Master state persistence, signal handling, notification triggers, and user-in-the-loop steering mechanisms for long-running asynchronous agent processes.

title: OpenAI Academy: Self-Paced AI Workflows and Agents Program
highlights: Comprehensive, self-paced learning path focused on building automated AI workflows, leveraging prompt engineering, and deploying custom workspace agents.
